svg.title: Silverline Appliance Collective dishwasher diagnosis portfolio concept
svg.desc: Fictional appliance repair portfolio concept for Silverline Appliance Collective, showing a careful dishwasher door and rack inspection. Purpose-built demonstration visual for LocalPro Directory; it does not depict a real business, credential, review or completed client project.
